name: Family sponsorship: status in 2026
description: Spouses, partners and dependent children remain the largest family stream; the Parents and Grandparents Program stopped taking new interest-to-sponsor forms on 15 July 2026.

attributes.jurisdiction: federal (IRCC); Quebec adds its own undertaking step
attributes.parents_and_grandparents_program: Intake paused 'until further notice' (IRCC notice of 15 July 2026); IRCC continues processing existing applications and plans up to 15,000 PR approvals in 2026. Last intake (2025) invited 17,860 potential sponsors from the 2020 pool. Processing: 23 months outside Quebec, 46 months for Quebec (as of 31 January 2026). Super visa remains the alternative for long visits.
attributes.status_dependency: Sponsoring requires the sponsor to be a Canadian citizen or permanent resident; relevant only after the user obtains PR (status unknown, USER-PROFILE.md).
